LunaSVG for VaCuus SVG rendering
================================
upstream: https://github.com/sammycage/lunasvg
tag: v3.5.0
commit: 83c58df8103dc7dca423dfd824992af94d49bed6
vendored: 2026-10-20

Copied include/, source/, LICENSE and CMakeLists.txt. The CMake file is reference
for the source list; UBT compiles the individual files through VaCuusRml relays.
Local patch: source/svgelement.cpp routes external image hrefs through
VaCuusVectorResources instead of host stdio. RmlUi scopes the base URI while
parsing both external and inline SVG. Embedded data images retain upstream behavior.
System font scanning is disabled; the SVG plugin registers VFS LatoLatin as the
default face. SVG text uses this font cache, independently of RmlUi's text engine.

PlutoVG is updated independently of LunaSVG's bundled snapshot:
upstream: https://github.com/sammycage/plutovg
tag: v1.3.3
commit: bbd91f0d06a71491691b36330f29dffa4af87ccf
Copied include/, source/, LICENSE and CMakeLists.txt into plutovg/. No source patches.
FTL.TXT is the FreeType license from rlottie's licenses/COPYING.FTL, required by
the borrowed rasterizer/stroker sources. Embedded stb headers retain their notices.
Both libraries use static declarations and source compilation inside VaCuusRml.
